g.title: line
g.text: a new line on a watched log

g.title: field
g.text: the watcher's indexed field is read off
the record... the daemon for syslog, the
most selective gate field for the rest,
or nothing when the rules pin nothing

g.title: lookup
g.text: the value of that field is then looked up in
the watcher's rule index, which maps each value
to the rules that could match a record carrying it

g.title: cands
g.text: the candidate list, config order kept...
the rules whose gate takes the value, the
rules pinning nothing on the field, and the
rules the index can not hold to a gate...
a capture, ignore, key, or track, or no
plain equality left to key on

g.title: tsyslog
g.text: a syslog rule opens with its daemons list...
the line's daemon must be one the rule names

g.title: thttp
g.text: a http rule opens with its

g.title: match
g.text: entries in order, first hit wins;
a staged rule advances its sequence instead;
with no matcher the boolean alone judges

g.title: sweep
g.text: each declared record takes this line's

g.title: cand
g.text: the offenders... each ban_var read out

g.title: scrub
g.text: under two names, or two names resolving

g.title: count
g.text: the hit is deposited... weight into the
find_time fall out; the subnet tally

g.title: ban
g.text: banishment... the ban sent to the
bucket cleared; a subnet that crossed
